films.title: The Mysterious Oriu Houses - Hidden in the Wilderness of Corsica
films.creator: Schwendi Colours
films.note: An on-location walk among the orii: natural granite cavities enclosed with stone walls. The film follows the heritage trail near Monacia-d’Aullène and a hillside extension.
films.placement_status: Regional guide; individual shelter pins pending exact identification

films.title: 500-Ton rocking stone on a mountain peak: Omu di Cagna in Corsica
films.creator: Schwendi Colours
films.note: Schwendi Colours follows the climb to Omu di Cagna and its naturally balanced granite boulder, with views across southern Corsica. A landscape hike alongside the island’s built heritage.
films.placement_status: Regional guide: natural geological landmark, not an archaeological site
